dishes.name: Buttery Scrambled Eggs on Toast
dishes.title: Soft scrambled eggs on wholemeal toast
dishes.method: Whisk the eggs and scramble them gently in a pan with the butter. Toast the bread and serve immediately.
dishes.why: A warm, protein-focused start for Marceau that requires no oven.

dishes.name: Sunflower Seed Butter Toast
dishes.title: Wholemeal toast with sunflower seed butter
dishes.method: Toast the bread and spread generously with the sunflower seed butter.
dishes.why: A safe, high-energy alternative to one of the foods on your medical list for Bertille.

dishes.name: Light Scrambled Eggs on Toast
dishes.title: Soft scrambled eggs on a single slice of toast
dishes.method: Scramble the eggs in butter and serve on a single slice of toasted bread.
dishes.why: Maintains the protein anchor while respecting Ysoline's smaller starch requirement.

dishes.name: Zesty Stovetop Lemon Chicken
dishes.title: Pan-seared lemon chicken with green beans and rice
dishes.method: Assemble the pre-cooked chicken, green beans, and rice. Squeeze fresh lemon over the top.
dishes.why: A loud vegetable lunch that uses the stovetop to avoid the broken oven.

dishes.name: Muscle Gain Lemon Chicken Bowl
dishes.title: Hearty pan-seared lemon chicken and extra rice
dishes.method: Assemble the chicken and rice, ensuring a larger portion of both as requested. Finish with lemon.
dishes.why: Fuels Bertille's muscle gain with increased protein and starch shares.

dishes.name: Lemon Chicken and Green Bean Plate
dishes.title: Lemon chicken with extra beans and light rice
dishes.method: Assemble the chicken and rice, prioritizing the green beans and a smaller rice portion.
dishes.why: Honours Ysoline's need for generous vegetables and a smaller starch share.

dishes.name: Golden Spinach and Lentil Dhal
dishes.title: Warm coconut dhal with spinach and flatbread
dishes.method: Reheat the dhal in a pan until bubbling. Warm the flatbread in a dry pan and serve.
dishes.why: A warm, comforting dinner that avoids the oven and features a loud vegetable.

dishes.name: Hearty Spinach Dhal Feast
dishes.title: Large portion of coconut dhal with extra flatbread
dishes.method: Reheat a generous portion of dhal and serve with extra warm flatbread.
dishes.why: Provides the larger starch and protein shares Bertille needs for her goal.

dishes.name: Vibrant Spinach and Lentil Bowl
dishes.title: Spinach-rich dhal with a small flatbread
dishes.method: Reheat the dhal, ensuring plenty of spinach is included, and serve with half a flatbread.
dishes.why: Focuses on generous vegetables and a reduced starch share for Ysoline.

preparations.title: Pan-Seared Lemon Chicken and Beans
preparations.method: Season chicken. Heat oil in a large pan and sear chicken thighs until golden and cooked through. Remove chicken, then sauté green beans and garlic in the same pan until tender. Stir in honey and a splash of water to glaze. Combine and box.

preparations.title: Fluffy Boiled Rice
preparations.method: Rinse rice and boil in salted water until tender. Drain and box.

preparations.title: Coconut, Spinach and Lentil Dhal
preparations.method: Sauté turmeric in oil, add lentils, coconut milk, and 200ml water. Simmer until lentils are soft. Stir in spinach until wilted. Box.

cooking_sessions.run_through: Start the rice boiling and the dhal simmering. While they cook, sear the chicken thighs in a large pan. Once the chicken is done, sauté the beans in the same pan. Wilt the spinach into the dhal last. Box all three components into the named containers.
